title: Rewards for Budget-Aware Multi-Turn Agents That Adapt to Arbitrary Test-Time Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2610.28409v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model agents are often given an inference budget and asked to maximise success within it. A multi-turn agent has to allocate this budget across many environment interactions. An external harness can enforce the budget, but it remains unclear whether the agent itself can learn when and how much to spend. We ask whether agents can learn this allocation across dynamically specified budgets and which rewards best teach this behaviour. We adapt existing length penalties to budget constraints spanning multiple resource types, introduce new reward formulations, and compare eleven objectives in a shared training pipeline. We train Qwen3.5 models at 4B and 9B on AppWorld with budgets over tokens, API calls, and environment steps, and on the BabyAI gridworld with turn budgets. translated_title: 适应任意测试时约束的预算感知多轮智能体奖励机制
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体通常会被赋予一个推理预算，并被要求在该预算内最大化成功率。多轮智能体必须将这一预算分配到多次环境交互之中。外部框架可以强制执行预算限制，但智能体本身能否学会何时花费以及花费多少预算，目前仍不清楚。我们探究了智能体能否学会在动态指定的预算之间进行这种分配，以及哪些奖励最能教会这种行为。我们将现有的长度惩罚方法适配到跨越多种资源类型的预算约束上，提出了新的奖励形式，并在一个共享的训练流程中比较了十一种目标函数。我们在AppWorld上以token、API调用和环境步骤作为预算，训练了4B和9B的Qwen3.5模型，并在BabyAI网格世界中以轮次预算进行训练。我们为每个环境和资源类型分别训练一个策略，且每个策略都在不同的预算值上进行训练。使用惩罚超支行为的奖励进行训练……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出并比较了十一种奖励目标函数，使大语言模型多轮智能体能够学会自主分配预算，并适应token、API调用、环境步骤等多种资源类型上动态指定的测试时约束。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes and compares eleven reward objectives that teach multi-turn LLM agents to learn when and how much budget to spend, enabling them to adapt to dynamically specified test-time constraints across multiple resource types such as tokens, API calls, and environment steps.
